create_color_palette: create a color palette list of RGB tuples for NYU40 semantic segmentation labels
read_label_mapping: read a TSV file and build a dictionary mapping label strings or ints to NYU40 IDs
read_scene_types_mapping: read a scene types TSV file and build a dictionary mapping scene names to integer IDs
visualize_label_image: visualize a semantic segmentation label image as a colored RGB image using the NYU40 palette
visualize_instance_image: visualize an instance segmentation image as a colored RGB image with unique instance colors
